async def ledger_record(record_id, tenant_id):
    entries = await AuditLedger().entries(tenant_id)
    entrada = next((e for e in entries if str(e.get("record_id")) == str(record_id)), None)
    if entrada is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"record '{record_id}' is not in the ledger")
    try:
        anclas = await anchors_of(tenant_id)
    except Exception:  # anchor store down: say so instead of claiming "unanchored"
        anclas = None
    return {"record_id": entrada["record_id"], "anchors": anclas}
